description: List recent jobs (transcribe, burn, caption_video, clips, dub, trim...) newest first for this key, or for every key on the account when the key is claimed: id, kind, status, created time, credits charged, and a download URL while the result is still stored. Free, read-only; needs a key. Paginated: limit (default 50, max 100) and cursor = nextCursor from the previous page. For one job's full status, progress and files use get_job; for credit totals per day use get_account.

api_key.description: Only for a connection without an Authorization header: the token create_key returned (av_live_...). Pass it on every call to use that key in this same session, no reconnect or config change. Ignored when the connection already sends a key. It works like a password: create a new key if this conversation is shared.

cursor.description: Opaque nextCursor from the previous page. Omit for the first page.

name: list_jobs

jobs.description: Jobs, newest first: id, kind, status, created, credits charged, download URL while available.

nextCursor.description: Pass as cursor for the next page; null on the last page.

title: List jobs
